title: Bitcoin: UTXO Count
note: Number of unspent Bitcoin transaction outputs in the UTXO set. The source is sampled intraday; this chart keeps the last Blockchain.com observation in each UTC day and omits the final observed day because it may be incomplete. One wallet can own many UTXOs, so this is not an address or user count.
